invariants.rationale: scheduleRestore returns a non-null Option to signal if a restore plan is present or absent; null would be an error.
restoreInstantTimestamp is passed to the executor and must be non-null for valid operation.
savepointToRestoreTimestamp is forwarded to the restore plan executor and must be non-null for successful processing.
context is required for engine actions (used in underlying executor), so it must be non-null at exit.
result is an Option, so its value is exhaustively either present or not; this is a basic property of Option.
